text.p: American HealthChoice Inc on Thursday said Dean York resigned as chief financial officer and that Wes Stucki would step down as chief executive.
Wes Stucki will continue to serve as chairman and as CEO on an interim basis. Jay Stucki, the company's in-house counsel, will serve as interim CFO.

The company, which operates medical clinics in three southern states, said it was now "evaluating" ways to improve profitability. The company is weighing possible asset sales, as well as the possibility of a merger.
It did not provide details, and officials there were not immediately available to comment.
